text: Debugging is an essential skill for any programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs by observing the symptoms and understanding what the code should do. Developers often use debugging tools such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution to find the exact location of a problem. A systematic approach is important: reproduce the error, isolate the cause, and test one change at a time. Logging is also very useful, because log messages record what happens while the program runs. By combining careful observation, good tools, and clear logs, programmers can solve problems faster and improve the quality of their software.
